snippet.title: Backgammon gameplay trailer: free two-player backgammon in your browser
snippet.description:
Backgammon is a two-player board game of dice and strategy. Each side races fifteen checkers around the board in opposite directions, hitting lone enemy checkers back to the start and bearing off to win. Matches go to five points with a doubling cube. Play online or against AI, free in the browser.

▶ Play free: https://nowplay.gg/games/backgammon
☀ Daily race, the same board and dice for every player: https://nowplay.gg/play/backgammon/daily
